name: rathflow-codex-plugin
description: Use RathFlow from Codex: inspect and operate projects, sessions, memory, sandboxes, and billing through the rathflow CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Operate RathFlow projects, sessions, memory, and billing
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to RathFlow through the installed rathflow CLI, and optionally through the bundled read-only MCP server. Codex can list and search projects, sessions, memory, and billing, and can run sandbox commands after you confirm.
defaultPrompt: Check RathFlow usage for the current project
